environment.observed_identity: ZoneTree 1.9.7.0; WAL=Sync; mutable segment default 1,000,000 items
environment.client_transport: embedded ZoneTree 1.9.7.0, one shared LSM per tree, Sync write-ahead log

limits: embedded reference: the measured member is this driver's own process, so the load generator and the database share one resource envelope
LSM with the default 1,000,000-item mutable segment: the whole working set stays in the mutable segment, writes are Sync WAL appends, and no disk segment forms during measurement
the write lane maintains the primary zone and the secondary (tenant, name) zone explicitly — the KV-store analogue of SQLite's two B-trees per indexed upsert
sync mode: the caller waits for each record in the plain WAL stream; full power-loss durability still depends on OS, filesystem, and device
